readings: reference: the arm's own run's LLM-only arm of its System-2 model (score card `family_references`: the episodes' main LLM decides, so routing arms count as Flash, as in the E2b score card)

front: pooled per suite x System-2 in paired relative coordinates (1 - savings, Delta-success vs the arm's own reference; the reference at (1, 0)); the within-run absolute (cost, success) front is a sensitivity column

bounded-recoverable is credited when either of its decision points reaches 5 % (tool choices / tool-selection opportunities, bounded arguments / argument slots); assist / guard / trigger whenever the arm has an opportunity

tau^2: the A5.4 (e) configurations on the 35 airline test tasks x 3 (majority pass for NI and the front); irreversible = WRITE tools of tau2-bench's airline toolkit + transfer_to_human_agents; ALFWorld (E6) not run
Kendall tau-b over the four class medians; exact permutation p over the 24 orderings (two-sided; p_less = P(tau <= observed) as the reversal side); tau-b undefined when a vector is constant
